notes: Access: direct HTTP fetch (tier 1) throughout; counts from the authoritative OCC REST API (apisap.fabindia.com/occ/v2/fabindiab2c/products/search?query=:relevancy:allCategories:<slug>), pagination.totalResults - same method validated in the prior Home-Decor pass for this company. 'New Arrivals' is a genuine standing top-level node in the site's own hamburger nav (FabHBArrivalsNavNode, title 'New Arrivals'), with real children All in New Arrivals, Women, Men, Kids, Home & Living, Furniture, Food (confirmed via full ng-state nav-tree dump). The sitewide 'All in New Arrivals' page (/shop/new-arrivals) mixes apparel (Women/Men/Kids) so its total is out of Home/Decor scope and was not used. Resolved the genuine Home & Living and Furniture children's real target URLs via the CMS components OCC endpoint (cms/components?componentIds=H_NA_HomeLivingLink,H_NA_FurnitureLink) to /shop/new-home-living and /shop/new-furniture - both are confirmed real PLPs (verified page <title>/meta description describe a browsable 'New X Collection', not editorial/marketing copy; no product total embedded in SSR since search results render client-side via the OCC API on this Angular/Spartacus site, same as the sitewide new-arrivals/sale pages - this is normal for this site and does not indicate a problem). Excluded Food (not decor). Also found ~10 deeper per-subcategory new-<slug> pages nested under Home & Living (e.g. new-home-decor=8, new-kitchen-dining=8, new-lighting=2, new-storage-utility=0, new-home-living-gifting=0) but reported at the department level (Home & Living / Furniture, matching the site's actual main-nav depth for this concept and avoiding re-deriving the full per-leaf-category catalog structure already covered by other category-specific deliverables). No 'Collection'-style ambiguous naming issue here - both pages are literally titled 'New ... Collection/Furniture', confirmed as genuine newly-added-product listings via title/meta, not lookbook/editorial pages.
